implementation: One existing paginated PRODUCTS_QUERY contains global and market aliases with returned Translation.market{id}. No second catalog pass. Primary locale skips both aliases; absent marketId skips the market alias.

Collector validates alias completeness, locale, returned market scope, unique keys, string values and boolean outdated states. Raw arrays are retained. Required title/body and optional handle are selected field by field, market first, before freshness filtering.
Selected records and field provenance are stored separately. An explicit empty selected handle is rejected; a truly absent handle retains the original source-handle behavior.

Generator recomputes from raw scopes, including rejecting provenance-marked products with missing raw scopes. Legacy unqualified arrays stay on their previous frozen-snapshot behavior and gain no invented global provenance.
Existing selected-stale required-field/handle checks and whole-feed failure return remain intact. No stale-partitioning or landingContextVerified bypass.
preserved_scope: Country, market identity, currency, contextual pricing, locale publication, product/variant IDs, eligibility/exclusion checks and return-policy logic unchanged.
All 39 existing tests and their helper files unchanged. No production configuration or any of the six holds changed.
